title: Averaging on graphs
notes: K-1 first route: P1, then one of the inverse-build collections P3 or P4; these can occupy the whole first visit. Offer linked circles in P2 only when children can keep every reference stack fixed and check each circle against that same unchanged board. On return, finish the other inverse collection or use P2 and P5-7 as readiness permits. Grades 2-3 can return to bounds and equality (P3-4), uniqueness (P5), or no-square collections (P6). Grades 4-5 can make P3 a first proof destination and save equality, difference-board uniqueness, components and fractions (P4-7) for deeper visits. Every circle condition is simultaneous; the copied sharing piles never replace the reference state.
